stops.name: Salem Moor
stops.quote: Its diversity of species and habitats is what makes it so special: white-tailed eagles circle above the waters, cranes trumpet as they fly in at dusk, moor frogs croak in the Salem Moor, and orchids grow in the ice age Hellbach Valley.
stops.english: Its diversity of species and habitats is what makes it so special: white-tailed eagles circle above the waters, cranes trumpet as they fly in at dusk, moor frogs croak in the Salem Moor, and orchids grow in the ice age Hellbach Valley.

stops.name: lake Schaalsee
stops.quote: Between lake Schaalsee and the Elbe-Lübeck canal, between Lübeck and Büchen, there is a vast mosaic landscape consisting of water, forest, meadows, fields and hedge walls.

stops.name: Naturparkzentrum Uhlenkolk
stops.quote: Exciting and diverse information is available at the nature park center “Naturparkzentrum Uhlenkolk” in Mölln.

stops.quote: The nature park with its hiking trails, viewing towers, information points, educational trails and picnic facilities is an interactive sanctuary for you to touch, experience and join in.
